cohort: The study included 166 high-risk pregnant women who underwent cervical cerclage, with or without recurrent vaginal infections.
finding: Appropriately treated prior vaginal infections before cerclage do not increase the risk of preterm birth, but were associated with lower offspring birth weight percentiles.
birth_weight: Offspring of mothers with prior vaginal infections had lower birth weight percentiles (p < 0.05).
gest_age: The median gestational age at birth was 38 weeks, regardless of the infection status.
